parameters.name: DedicatedHostId
parameters.description: The ID of the dedicated host.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: TerminateSubscription
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to release an expired subscription dedicated host.

- true: Releases the host.
- false: Does not release the host.

Default value: false.
